acceptance: `evolve comments verify` on a comment-only fixture diff reports equivalence as `go run ./cmd/commentaudit verify` does (red: unknown command)
A relative directory argument works for verify
fix: Add `evolve comments <rank|check|comments|verify> …`, delegating to commentaudit.Main with the same git seam and resolving relative directory arguments to absolute ones before the call. The exit codes are commentaudit's. Keep cmd/commentaudit as a thin wrapper or delete it. Document it in runtime-reference.md and in the comment campaign's design note.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: internal/commentaudit.Main implements rank, check, comments and verify (cli.go:23-75), reachable only through `go run ./cmd/commentaudit`. The commit gate uses commentaudit.Equivalent only for its comment-only waiver (commitgate/comment_only.go:73). Every comment-reduction round runs the separate binary, which needs a Go toolchain in the tree and absolute directories for verify.
title: The comment campaign's proof tools (rank, check, verify) run only as `go run ./cmd/commentaudit`, a separate binary; add `evolve comments`
